Home Décor-Hipo Bookend (H-21.2CM)

Bring a playful yet elegant touch to your reading corner with this Hippo Bookend. Crafted with exquisite detailing, this two-piece bookend features a golden hippo split in half – one side roaring, the other calmly resting – creating a striking visual while holding your books upright. The swirling engraved patterns and black base add a luxurious, artistic flair that complements both modern and traditional interiors. Perfect for book lovers who enjoy quirky yet classy décor. Add a bold yet whimsical statement to your bookshelf with this Hippo Bookend. Measuring 21.2 cm in height, this two-piece décor accessory is as functional as it is artistic. Each half of the hippo is sculpted with meticulous attention to detail—one end captures the open-mouthed roar of a hippopotamus, while the other shows its powerful back and tail. Together, they cradle your books securely while transforming your shelf into a miniature gallery. Finished in a rich gold tone with intricate spiral engravings and subtle black accents, the Hippo Bookend combines the feel of hand-crafted artistry with modern styling. The sturdy black base ensures that both halves stand firmly, even when holding heavier hardbacks or oversized volumes. This versatile piece is ideal for living rooms, studies, offices, or even children’s reading nooks, offering a playful twist to conventional bookends. It makes a striking gift for book lovers, wildlife enthusiasts, or anyone who appreciates quirky yet refined home décor.

Features

  • Unique Design: Two-piece hippo sculpture acting as functional bookends.
  • Premium Finish: Gold-toned surface with intricate swirl engravings for a luxurious look.
  • Durable Construction: Made from high-quality polyresin (or resin/metal mix, depending on manufacturer).
  • Stable Base: Mounted on sturdy black platforms for balance and book support.
  • Perfect Size: Height approx. 21.2 cm; ideal for shelves, desks, or side tables.
  • Functional & Decorative: Keeps books organized while serving as an eye-catching décor piece.
  • Gift-Ready: Great choice for Home Décor, birthdays, or as a stylish office/library accessory.
  • MOQ- 40Pc.
